AnalysisContracts.description: Versioned contract identifiers used to interpret one analysis stage.

analysis_summary_schema.description: Analysis-summary artifact schema written by the stage.

derived_stream_schema.description: Derived NDJSON stream schema written by the stage.

health_schema.description: Health artifact schema interpreted by the stage.

hotspots_schema.description: Hotspot artifact schema supported by the stage.

AnalysisDiagnosticCounts.description: Counts that remain useful for diagnosis even when quantitative results are gated.

function_span_count.description: Number of derived function-span records emitted, including incomplete spans.

health_issue_count.description: Number of diagnosed health issues retained by the health report.

health_observation_count.description: Number of raw health observations retained by the health report.

incomplete_function_span_count.description: Number of derived spans excluded from trusted aggregation.

observation_count.description: Number of normalized observations consumed by the analyzer.

Artifact.description: One immutable file artifact and its provenance.

id.description: Stable artifact identifier unique within the session.

input_artifact_ids.description: Artifact identifiers consumed to produce this artifact.

kind.description: Extensible artifact kind such as `raw_trace` or `perfetto`.

media_type.description: IANA media type of the file.

producer.description: Tool or stage identifier that produced the file.

relative_path.description: Canonical path relative to the session directory.

sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the complete file.

HealthVerdict.description: Host-policy verdict for the trustworthiness of a capture.

oneOf.description: Quantitative results and strict comparisons are permitted.
Timeline inspection is permitted, but strict comparison is not.

MetricSupport.description: Support matrix covering all required timeline and timing metrics.

active.description: Support for active function duration excluding preemption.

call_count.description: Support for exact or estimated function call counts.

elapsed.description: Support for wall-clock elapsed function duration.

function_timeline.description: Support for reconstructed function timeline slices.

isr_timeline.description: Support for the interrupt execution timeline.

resource_counters.description: Support for explicitly defined numeric resource counters.

self.description: Support for self active function duration excluding children.

task_timeline.description: Support for the task execution timeline.

MetricSupportEntry.description: Support and explanatory reasons for one metric.

reasons.description: Stable or human-readable reasons for the declared level.

MetricSupportLevel.description: The support level for one analysis metric.

oneOf.description: The capture directly supports exact computation.
The metric can be deterministically inferred with documented caveats.
Only a statistical estimate is available.
The capture cannot support this metric.

ToolInfo.description: Version and provenance of the t32perf tool writing a manifest.

version.description: Tool semantic version or build version.

description: Immutable receipt binding an analysis run to exact input and output bytes.

contracts.description: Versioned contracts used by the stage.

diagnostics.description: Diagnostic counts bound to the output documents.

health_verdict.description: Health verdict produced by the declared policy.

input_artifacts.description: Exact immutable external inputs to the analysis stage.

metric_support.description: Metric support produced by the declared policy.

output_artifacts.description: Exact immutable outputs committed before this receipt.

session_id.description: Session that owns every claimed artifact.

tool.description: Tool build that executed the stage.
